uncertain: 207:t_016:5: 除隊を許可する rendered 'I authorize... your discharge' (Sousuke releasing Al from service).

207:t_017:17: Leonard's 何故、あの男に... rendered 'Why... to that man...' (the trailing verb is cut off in Japanese).
